validation.wrapper: Reads the task-owned PostgreSQL container connection settings into the child environment without printing credentials, then invokes .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest with the listed arguments.
validation.portable_reproduction: Supply SOURCE_INGEST_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN and run the identical suites directly with .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest; see README.md.

deployment_notes: Owner bootstrap adds immutable SQL linkage reducer, generated columns, summary covering index and linkage GIN index. Existing-row migration and repeated bootstrap tested.
Schema migration requires source-owner DDL privileges and a table rewrite/lock. If SOURCE_INGEST_EVIDENCE_BOOTSTRAP is disabled, apply owner schema migration before enabling the new reader.
Read-only source-record consumers retain their prior query and do not bootstrap schema.
No hosted deployment, browser result, FE/BFF served identity, production load or other live behavior is claimed.
